titleEn: Minimum Time to Visit Disappearing Nodes
title: 访问消失节点的最少时间
summary: 在带非负权的无向图中从节点零出发，节点 i 在 disappear[i] 时刻及以后不能访问；返回到每个节点的最短合法到达时间，不可达则为负一。
insight: 边权均为正，最短到达时间仍满足 Dijkstra 的贪心性质。唯一新增的限制是在松弛边时，候选到达时间必须严格小于目标节点的消失时间；不满足的路径及其所有更慢替代路径都无需入队。
pitfalls: 到达时间必须严格小于 disappear[i]，恰好相等也不可访问
图可能不连通且两个节点间可能有多条边
起点在时刻零已经到达，题目保证它的消失时间至少为一
优先队列可能包含旧距离，弹出后要跳过失效状态
使用 long 计算候选路径长度，再按题目范围转换为 int 答案

solutions.title: 带消失截止时间的 Dijkstra
solutions.idea: 在标准 Dijkstra 松弛条件中加入到达时间早于节点消失时间的限制。
steps: 把所有距离初始化为无穷并令 distance[0]=0
把起点加入按到达时间排序的小根堆
反复弹出最早状态并跳过旧距离
只有 candidate 更短且 candidate<disappear[next] 时才更新并入队
把仍为无穷的节点写为负一，其余距离转为整数

code.java: class Solution { public int[] minimumTime(int n,int[][] edges,int[] disappear){List<int[]>[] graph=new ArrayList[n];for(int node=0;node<n;node++)graph[node]=new ArrayList<>();for(int[] edge:edges){graph[edge[0]].add(new int[]{edge[1],edge[2]});graph[edge[1]].add(new int[]{edge[0],edge[2]});}long[] distance=new long[n];Arrays.fill(distance,Long.MAX_VALUE);distance[0]=0;PriorityQueue<long[]> queue=new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(state->state[0]));queue.add(new long[]{0,0});while(!queue.isEmpty()){long[] state=queue.poll();long time=state[0];int node=(int)state[1];if(time!=distance[node])continue;for(int[] edge:graph[node]){int next=edge[0];long candidate=time+edge[1];if(candidate<distance[next]&&candidate<disappear[next]){distance[next]=candidate;queue.add(new long[]{candidate,next});}}}int[] answer=new int[n];for(int node=0;node<n;node++)answer[node]=distance[node]==Long.MAX_VALUE?-1:(int)distance[node];return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minimumTime(n:Int,edges:Array<IntArray>,disappear:IntArray):IntArray{val graph=Array(n){mutableListOf<IntArray>()};for(edge in edges){graph[edge[0]].add(intArrayOf(edge[1],edge[2]));graph[edge[1]].add(intArrayOf(edge[0],edge[2]))};val distance=LongArray(n){Long.MAX_VALUE};distance[0]=0;val queue=java.util.PriorityQueue<LongArray>(compareBy<LongArray>{it[0]});queue.add(longArrayOf(0,0));while(queue.isNotEmpty()){val state=queue.poll();val time=state[0];val node=state[1].toInt();if(time!=distance[node])continue;for(edge in graph[node]){val next=edge[0];val candidate=time+edge[1];if(candidate<distance[next]&&candidate<disappear[next]){distance[next]=candidate;queue.add(longArrayOf(candidate,next.toLong()))}}};return IntArray(n){if(distance[it]==Long.MAX_VALUE)-1 else distance[it].toInt()}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<int> minimumTime(int n,vector<vector<int>>& edges,vector<int>& disappear){vector<vector<pair<int,int>>> graph(n);for(auto& edge:edges){graph[edge[0]].push_back({edge[1],edge[2]});graph[edge[1]].push_back({edge[0],edge[2]});}vector<long long> distance(n,LLONG_MAX);priority_queue<pair<long long,int>,vector<pair<long long,int>>,greater<pair<long long,int>>> queue;distance[0]=0;queue.push({0,0});while(!queue.empty()){auto [time,node]=queue.top();queue.pop();if(time!=distance[node])continue;for(auto [next,weight]:graph[node]){long long candidate=time+weight;if(candidate<distance[next]&&candidate<disappear[next]){distance[next]=candidate;queue.push({candidate,next});}}}vector<int> answer(n);for(int node=0;node<n;++node)answer[node]=distance[node]==LLONG_MAX?-1:distance[node];return answer;} };
